category_title: Students with non-compliant behavior and difficulty accepting instructions or consequences
minimal_context: Garth is sitting at his desk with a textbook and worksheet to complete his independent academic work.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Garth, please open your textbook and start working on the worksheet at your desk.

STUDENT: (Makes a loud buzzing noise with his mouth and stares at the wall) I'm not doing it.

TUTOR: You need to get started on your independent work now.

STUDENT: This is stupid and you can't make me do it! (Pushes the textbook aggressively across the desk)

TUTOR: If you don't complete the assignment, there will be consequences.

STUDENT: I don't care! Shut up! (Rips the worksheet in half and throws it on the floor)

options.A: Implement relatively tight timelines for completing the independent worksheet tasks, requiring the student to finish the assigned textbook work within a strictly limited period.
options.B: Represent information in various ways by including movement and physical activity to represent textbook concepts during the student's independent work sessions in the classroom.
options.C: Evaluate the accuracy of the student's recording by having a data recorder score the same behaviors, and give feedback regarding accuracy to the student following each session.
options.D: Use Evernote to take notes, organize independent work, and archive past worksheet assignments throughout the duration of the student's academic sessions in the classroom.
